messages:
maria: Deploy bot failed to promote release v2.4.1 to prod — see CI job 4872 output. Artifact fetch error: checksum mismatch.
deploy-bot: Promotion failed in step `fetch-artifact` for release v2.4.1. Error: `checksum_mismatch`. Logs: https://ci.redwood/4872
kevin: I tried pulling the image referenced by the manifest, registry returns 404 for some blobs. Looks like cache/TLC eviction on registry side.
sujata: Is the change window still open? We need a decision: rollback canary or try to repair artifacts.
maria: Change window ends in ~25m. Canary is at 10% traffic. If we wait too long we risk customer impact.
kevin: My vote: rollback canary to previous digest and re-run build that produced the artifact, force upload (no-cache). Reupload will give a new digest and we can pin.
dave: +1 rollback. Starting rollback and notifying infra. @oncall can you check registry GC events?
infra-bot: Registry GC started at 1958882000 by retention-policy-runner. Affected repos: `redwood/runtime`, `redwood/console`. Investigating blob availability.
sujata: If GC removed blobs, reuploading the same build may not yield the same digest if any layer is rebuilt. We should rebuild from the same commit and update release manifest to the new digest, then QA smoke test.
maria: Ok action list: 1) @dave rollback canary -> `sha:abc123def` now, 2) @kevin trigger hotfix build and force upload, 3) @sujata run smoke tests, 4) @oncall keep us updated on registry restore. I'll hold promotion to prod and update release notes.
dave: rollback command running: ``/deploy rollback --service=api --to-digest=abc123def --reason="artifact mismatch"``
deploy-bot: Rollback in progress for `service=api`. Started by dave. Estimated ~3m to complete.
kevin: Hotfix build queued: CI job 4880. Will build from commit `commit:94f2a` and push with `--no-cache` and `--pin-manifest`.
maria: Good. Holding promotion until CI 4880 + QA pass. Extending change window by 30m.
infra-bot: Registry GC paused. Restoration of deleted blobs from backup initiated; ETA ~20m if needed.
sujata: CI 4880 passed and artifacts uploaded. Smoke tests on staging: 2/2 green. Tagging @maria.
maria: Awesome — once deploy-bot finishes rollback, re-run promote to prod with pinned manifest. I'll update release notes: include rollback + hotfix + registry GC note. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Promotion currently blocked awaiting explicit `promote` command.
dave: I triggered rollback and will kick the promote after final confirmation.
kevin: Leaving note in release log: "hotfix build 4880 produced new manifest sha:def456789, pinned; previous canary rolled back to abc123def; registry GC noted and handled."
maria: Thanks team. I'll file a short postmortem and coordinate with infra to avoid automated GC during change windows.
infra-bot: Incident ticket #INC-2026-389 created for registry GC and retention policy tuning.
dave: Closing thread. Will follow up with postmortem doc link once ready.
